profile.headline: Senior iOS developer who understands the importance of product and UX and loves to raise ideas.
profile.summary:
I build iOS apps that feel right. The kind that make you think, “Oh, that’s exactly where that button should be.”

Over the past decade, I’ve led development of large and small iOS apps, shipped flagship products, and helped shape the mobile experience for thousands of users at Kajabi. My work spans consumer-facing apps, white-label platforms, and indie side projects I’ve launched myself.

I love collaborating across design, product, and backend teams to turn ideas into smooth, intuitive apps that just work. My toolbox includes the old along with the modern iOS stack,  SwiftUI, UIKit, MVVM, Swift Concurrency, Fastlane, etc… and a steady dose of curiosity.

Reach out to chat about iOS development or technology in general. I also accept good restaurant suggestions!

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description: My role as a mobile application developer encompasses many different areas. A large portion of work involves development of mobile apps for iOS in both Objective-C and Swift. Other responsibilities include maintenance of Cordova cross-platform applications, updating of SQL databases, and upkeep of relevant application certifications.
